About this item

  • Humidor: A medley of aged tobacco leaves, aged leather and ambered musk
  • The wooden wick of our Hearthwick flame candles creates a long, beautiful dancing flame for fireplace-like ambiance
  • Premium paraffin and soy waxes are blended with highly concentrated fragrances to produce a beautiful burn with no messy residue
  • Ellipse shape creates a wider opening for a fully melted wax pool that produces a more consistent fragrance experience

Product Description

Experience the cozy comfort of a glowing fireplace anywhere in your home. The soothing crackle and long, dancing flame of WoodWick with Hearthwick Flame allows you to relive fond memories or create new ones in a warm, comfortable atmosphere. So enjoy more than just a candle, because home is where the HEARTH is. (7.5" x 4.75" x 3.63")

    Customer Reviews, including Product Star Ratings help customers to learn more about the product and decide whether it is the right product for them.

    Do You Know what it Means to Miss New Orleans….🎶
    Ever wonder what the warm and rich aromas coming from the mystical New Orleans smells like? Well, this is it…. To my husband and I, it embodies the all-encompassing fragrances there such as musky flowers, fresh soil (in the best way possible, I promise!), an undertone of cigars, hot beignets, and a hint of magic…. We’re just so enamored by this candle’s scent that we purchased two more! Take it from us - we sure do know what it means to miss New Orleans, and having this scent in our home will get us through the next few weeks until we go back! 💜💚⚜️💜💚⚜️

    About this Item

    • Humidor: A medley of aged tobacco leaves, aged leather and ambered musk
    • The wooden wick of our Hearthwick flame candles creates a long, beautiful dancing flame for fireplace-like ambiance
    • Premium paraffin and soy waxes are blended with highly concentrated fragrances to produce a beautiful burn with no messy residue
    • Ellipse shape creates a wider opening for a fully melted wax pool that produces a more consistent fragrance experience

    Product Description

    Experience the cozy comfort of a glowing fireplace anywhere in your home. The soothing crackle and long, dancing flame of WoodWick with Hearthwick Flame allows you to relive fond memories or create new ones in a warm, comfortable atmosphere. So enjoy more than just a candle, because home is where the HEARTH is. (7.5" x 4.75" x 3.63")
